description: Connection reuse: the shared MCP server's tools send HTTP/1.1 requests to two shared destinations through a client whose keep-alive pool is shared by every session (httpx, aiohttp, requests), or through a new client per call (httpx_fresh, control). The destination logs each request's byte ranges and operation id (independent per-request reference). Byte attribution is scored with the identity of the connection's opener and with the identity at each send (fact_rt send binding on or off). Collector fact-bytes.bt.
